design.target: Entire 1km blocks contained in preset 17.28km square
design.training: All same-source inventory records, excluding whole heldout block and rectangular 250m buffer; neither heldout block nor buffer enters model source-pool or baseline
design.projection: Production gameXZ exact WGS84 local linearization; scale1 rotation0
design.query: Actual exported compositionSampler at heldout block center, {urban:true}; no heldout coordinates or labels supplied
design.regional_baseline: Training-only genus frequencies within 25000m of square center, symmetric pseudocount alpha=0; zero means unsmoothed source-pool proportions
design.reporting: Equal-weight paired block mean over blocks with local estimates; zero-share taxa scored with clipped probability1e-9 only for log-loss, also report their true test mass
design.unknown: Unknown predictions excluded from both paired mean scores; coverage and unknown counts reported explicitly, not silently imputed
limitations: Within-source spatial transfer is not independent-source or cross-city validation.
No abundance, individual height/crown, wild-versus-planted, or natural-only validation.
Taxon vocabulary is source-wide; frequencies are strictly training-only.
Final source-pool fallback was selected after the local-k24 benchmark failed; final results are not an untouched model-selection holdout.
